newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cenbank sells 182-day BBCs at 2.287 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cenbank sells 182-day BBCs at 2.287 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 906 million reais of 182-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) Tuesday at an overnight call money rate of 2.287 percent a month, dealers said.
The rate at the bank's weekly formal bond auction was down from 2.37 percent at last week's sale, and was in line with market expectations.
The auction results show that 94 million reais will be enter the banking system as 1.0 billion reais in 56-day old bonds come due Wednesday.
